items.name: Polynomial.natDegree_det_X_add_C_le
items.type: {n : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} [DecidableEq n] [Fintype n] [CommRing α] (A B : Matrix n n α) : (Polynomial.X • A.map ⇑Polynomial.C + B.map ⇑Polynomial.C).det.natDegree ≤ Fintype.card n

items.name: Matrix.det_matrixOfPolynomials

items.name: Matrix.det_eval_matrixOfPolynomials_eq_det_vandermonde
